name: cn-edge-redirect
description: CN visitors use the optional nearby overseas fallback line; keep disabled until EdgeOne has passed carrier tests.
expression: (ip.src.country eq "CN" and http.host eq "xingx.cc.cd" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known") and http.request.uri.path ne "/robots.txt" and http.request.uri.path ne "/rss.xml" and http.request.uri.path ne "/sitemap.xml")
